summary: Authored a 7-phase, 10-hour plan for making the orchestration close own the full gate battery. Research found Deliverables 1 and 6 already shipped by prior work, so the plan covers only the genuinely open ground: the plan-format final-phase vocabulary amendment, a durable attributed per-task record for a red close plus an attributed-cause-only status demotion, the interrupted-invocation obligation, and the consumer-repository closing-gate reader. Two stale prose surfaces beyond the research report were found at planning time and folded into Phase 1. The plan validates clean with zero warnings.
